1 class Battle::Battler
    2   #=============================================================================
    3   # Effect per hit
    4   #=============================================================================
    5   def pbEffectsOnMakingHit(move, user, target)
    6     if target.damageState.calcDamage > 0 && !target.damageState.substitute
    7       # Target's ability
    8       if target.abilityActive?(true)
    9         oldHP = user.hp
   10         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnBeingHit(target.ability, user, target, move, @battle)
   11         user.pbItemHPHealCheck if user.hp < oldHP
   12       end
   13       # Cramorant - Gulp Missile
   14       if target.isSpecies?(:CRAMORANT) && target.ability == :GULPMISSILE &&
   15          target.form > 0 && !target.effects[PBEffects::Transform]
   16         oldHP = user.hp
   17         # NOTE: Strictly speaking, an attack animation should be shown (the
   18         #       target Cramorant attacking the user) and the ability splash
   19         #       shouldn't be shown.
   20         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
   21         target.pbChangeForm(0, nil)
   22         if user.takesIndirectDamage?(Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH)
   23           @battle.scene.pbDamageAnimation(user)
   24           user.pbReduceHP(user.totalhp / 4, false)
   25         end
   26         case target.form
   27         when 1   # Gulping Form
   28           user.pbLowerStatStageByAbility(:DEFENSE, 1, target, false)
   29         when 2   # Gorging Form
   30           user.pbParalyze(target) if user.pbCanParalyze?(target, false)
   31         end
   32         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
   33         user.pbItemHPHealCheck if user.hp < oldHP
   34       end
   35       # User's ability
   36       if user.abilityActive?(true)
   37         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnDealingHit(user.ability, user, target, move, @battle)
   38         user.pbItemHPHealCheck
   39       end
   40       # Target's item
   41       if target.itemActive?(true)
   42         oldHP = user.hp
   43         Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnBeingHit(target.item, user, target, move, @battle)
   44         user.pbItemHPHealCheck if user.hp < oldHP
   45       end
   46     end
   47     if target.opposes?(user)
   48       # Rage
   49       if target.effects[PBEffects::Rage] && !target.fainted? &&
   50          target.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(:ATTACK, target)
   51         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s rage is building!", target.pbThis))
   52         target.pbRaiseStatStage(:ATTACK, 1, target)
   53       end
   54       # Beak Blast
   55       if target.effects[PBEffects::BeakBlast]
   56         PBDebug.log("[Lingering effect] #{target.pbThis}'s Beak Blast")
   57         if move.pbContactMove?(user) && user.affectedByContactEffect? &&
   58            user.pbCanBurn?(target, false, self)
   59           user.pbBurn(target)
   60         end
   61       end
   62       # Shell Trap (make the trapper move next if the trap was triggered)
   63       if target.effects[PBEffects::ShellTrap] && move.physicalMove? &&
   64          @battle.choices[target.index][0] == :UseMove && !target.movedThisRound? &&
   65          target.damageState.hpLost > 0 && !target.damageState.substitute
   66         target.tookPhysicalHit              = true
   67         target.effects[PBEffects::MoveNext] = true
   68         target.effects[PBEffects::Quash]    = 0
   69       end
   70       # Grudge
   71       if target.effects[PBEffects::Grudge] && target.fainted?
   72         user.pbSetPP(move, 0)
   73         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} lost all of its PP due to the grudge!",
   74                                 user.pbThis, move.name))
   75       end
   76       # Destiny Bond (recording that it should apply)
   77       if target.effects[PBEffects::DestinyBond] && target.fainted? &&
   78          user.effects[PBEffects::DestinyBondTarget] < 0
   79         user.effects[PBEffects::DestinyBondTarget] = target.index
   80       end
   81     end
   82   end

   84   #=============================================================================
   85   # Effects after all hits (i.e. at end of move usage)
   86   #=============================================================================
   87   def pbEffectsAfterMove(user, targets, move, numHits)
   88     # Defrost
   89     if move.damagingMove?
   90       targets.each do |b|
   91         next if b.damageState.unaffected || b.damageState.substitute
   92         next if b.status != :FROZEN
   93         # NOTE: Non-Fire-type moves that thaw the user will also thaw the
   94         #       target (in Gen 6+).
   95         if move.calcType == :FIRE || (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6 && move.thawsUser?)
   96           b.pbCureStatus
   97         end
   98       end
   99     end
  100     # Destiny Bond
  101     # NOTE: Although Destiny Bond is similar to Grudge, they don't apply at
  102     #       the same time (however, Destiny Bond does check whether it's going
  103     #       to trigger at the same time as Grudge).
  104     if user.effects[PBEffects::DestinyBondTarget] >= 0 && !user.fainted?
  105       dbName = @battle.battlers[user.effects[PBEffects::DestinyBondTarget]].pbThis
  106       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} took its attacker down with it!", dbName))
  107       user.pbReduceHP(user.hp, false)
  108       user.pbItemHPHealCheck
  109       user.pbFaint
  110       @battle.pbJudgeCheckpoint(user)
  111     end
  112     # User's ability
  113     if user.abilityActive?
  114       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnEndOfUsingMove(user.ability, user, targets, move, @battle)
  115     end
  116     if !user.fainted? && !user.effects[PBEffects::Transform] &&
  117        !@battle.pbAllFainted?(user.idxOpposingSide)
  118       # Greninja - Battle Bond
  119       if user.isSpecies?(:GRENINJA) && user.ability == :BATTLEBOND &&
  120          !@battle.battleBond[user.index & 1][user.pokemonIndex]
  121         numFainted = 0
  122         targets.each { |b| numFainted += 1 if b.damageState.fainted }
  123         if numFainted > 0 && user.form == 1
  124           @battle.battleBond[user.index & 1][user.pokemonIndex] = true
  125           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} became fully charged due to its bond with its Trainer!", user.pbThis))
  126           @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(user, true)
  127           @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(user)
  128           user.pbChangeForm(2, _INTL("{1} became Ash-Greninja!", user.pbThis))
  129         end
  130       end
  131       # Cramorant = Gulp Missile
  132       if user.isSpecies?(:CRAMORANT) && user.ability == :GULPMISSILE && user.form == 0 &&
  133          ((move.id == :SURF && numHits > 0) || (move.id == :DIVE && move.chargingTurn))
  134         # NOTE: Intentionally no ability splash or message here.
  135         user.pbChangeForm((user.hp > user.totalhp / 2) ? 1 : 2, nil)
  136       end
  137     end
  138     # Room Service
  139     if move.function_code == "StartSlowerBattlersActFirst" && @battle.field.effects[PBEffects::TrickRoom] > 0
  140       @battle.allBattlers.each do |b|
  141         next if !b.hasActiveItem?(:ROOMSERVICE)
  142         next if !b.pbCanLowerStatStage?(:SPEED)
  143         @battle.pbCommonAnimation("UseItem", b)
  144         b.pbLowerStatStage(:SPEED, 1, nil)
  145         b.pbConsumeItem
  146       end
  147     end
  148     # Consume user's Gem
  149     if user.effects[PBEffects::GemConsumed]
  150       # NOTE: The consume animation and message for Gems are shown immediately
  151       #       after the move's animation, but the item is only consumed now.
  152       user.pbConsumeItem
  153     end
  154     switched_battlers = []   # Indices of battlers that were switched out somehow
  155     # Target switching caused by Roar, Whirlwind, Circle Throw, Dragon Tail
  156     move.pbSwitchOutTargetEffect(user, targets, numHits, switched_battlers)
  157     # Target's item, user's item, target's ability (all negated by Sheer Force)
  158     if !(user.hasActiveAbility?(:SHEERFORCE) && move.addlEffect > 0)
  159       pbEffectsAfterMove2(user, targets, move, numHits, switched_battlers)
  160     end
  161     # Some move effects that need to happen here, i.e. user switching caused by
  162     # U-turn/Volt Switch/Baton Pass/Parting Shot, Relic Song's form changing,
  163     # Fling/Natural Gift consuming item.
  164     if !switched_battlers.include?(user.index)
  165       move.pbEndOfMoveUsageEffect(user, targets, numHits, switched_battlers)
  166     end
  167     # User's ability/item that switches the user out (all negated by Sheer Force)
  168     if !(user.hasActiveAbility?(:SHEERFORCE) && move.addlEffect > 0)
  169       pbEffectsAfterMove3(user, targets, move, numHits, switched_battlers)
  170     end
  171     if numHits > 0
  172       @battle.allBattlers.each { |b| b.pbItemEndOfMoveCheck }
  173     end
  174   end

  176   # Everything in this method is negated by Sheer Force.
  177   def pbEffectsAfterMove2(user, targets, move, numHits, switched_battlers)
  178     # Target's held item (Eject Button, Red Card, Eject Pack)
  179     @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
  180       if targets.any? { |targetB| targetB.index == b.index } &&
  181          !b.damageState.unaffected && b.damageState.calcDamage > 0 && b.itemActive?
  182         Battle::ItemEffects.triggerAfterMoveUseFromTarget(b.item, b, user, move, switched_battlers, @battle)
  183       end
  184       # Target's Eject Pack
  185       if switched_battlers.empty? && b.index != user.index && b.pbItemOnStatDropped(user)
  186         switched_battlers.push(b.index)
  187       end
  188     end
  189     # User's held item (Life Orb, Shell Bell, Throat Spray, Eject Pack)
  190     if !switched_battlers.include?(user.index) && user.itemActive?   # Only if user hasn't switched out
  191       Battle::ItemEffects.triggerAfterMoveUseFromUser(user.item, user, targets, move, numHits, @battle)
  192     end
  193     # Target's ability (Berserk, Color Change, Emergency Exit, Pickpocket, Wimp Out)
  194     @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
  195       if targets.any? { |targetB| targetB.index == b.index } &&
  196          !b.damageState.unaffected && !switched_battlers.include?(b.index) && b.abilityActive?
  197         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerAfterMoveUseFromTarget(b.ability, b, user, move, switched_battlers, @battle)
  198       end
  199       # Target's Emergency Exit, Wimp Out (including for Pokémon hurt by Flame Burst)
  200       if switched_battlers.empty? && move.damagingMove? &&
  201          b.index != user.index && b.pbAbilitiesOnDamageTaken(user)
  202         switched_battlers.push(b.index)
  203       end
  204     end
  205   end

  207   # Everything in this method is negated by Sheer Force.
  208   def pbEffectsAfterMove3(user, targets, move, numHits, switched_battlers)
  209     # User's held item that switches it out (Eject Pack)
  210     if switched_battlers.empty? && user.pbItemOnStatDropped(user)
  211       switched_battlers.push(user.index)
  212     end
  213     # User's ability (Emergency Exit, Wimp Out)
  214     if switched_battlers.empty? && move.damagingMove? && user.pbAbilitiesOnDamageTaken(user)
  215       switched_battlers.push(user.index)
  216     end
  217   end
  218 end
